name: Priyanka Banerjee

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Priyanka Banerjee is a Kolkata poet whose literary work sits alongside teaching and research. Contributor notes in INNSÆI and Research Scholar connect her with Rabindra Bharati University, an M.Phil. on William Morris’s poetry and research in American literature. Her work has appeared in international literary journals; the biography supplied to Kabita Live also names the collection Touches and Turbulences.

Her two poems here take different routes through time and feeling. “TRANSITION” looks back from adulthood, using changing colours and a lighthouse to consider what experience teaches. “SHADOWS OF SHADOWS” moves through woods, mist, glaciers and stars toward an intimate question about love and loss. Its shifting scale lets private longing open into a much larger, unsettled world.
